blocks.raw: <Tip>Memorize gauge-to-thickness pairs: Gauge 26 = 0.46 mm, Gauge 24 = 0.61 mm, Gauge 22 = 0.76 mm. Remember ASTM A653 G90 = Z275 metric equivleant. In tropical zones, default to G90 unless project budget forces G60.</Tip>

props.mistake: Confusing gauge numbers with thickness: assuming Gauge 30 is thicker than Gauge 26.
props.correction: Lower gauge numbers indicate thicker material. Gauge 26 (0.46 mm) is standard; Gauge 30 (0.31 mm) is thinner and not used for primary roofing in Philippines.
